fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/UtilityPages/TyresListingBrands.cy.js#UtilityPages - TyresListing [continentalTyres] [en] [desktop] — Continental Tyres TC-TYRL-03: a second Load More still adds tyre cards on Continental Tyres
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-TYRL-03
**Title:** A second Load More still adds tyre cards on Continental Tyres
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Click Load More once on Continental Tyres, then again if it is still shown, and confirm the card list keeps growing.

**Expected Result:**
The first Load More adds cards. If Load More remains, a second click adds still more cards.

**Steps:**
1. Open Continental Tyres
2. Click Load More and verify more cards
3. Click Load More again if it is still shown
